visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing glasses, a black t-shirt, and black shorts stands in a brightly lit arcade aisle, speaking enthusiastically to the camera while gesturing with his hands. Beside him, a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a cream-colored ribbed cardigan and black trousers, walks and smiles. The background is filled with rows of yellow and white claw machines under bright indoor fluorescent lighting. (2) The man moves closer to a large yellow claw machine with KING KONG printed in blue and yellow letters on top, featuring a blue robot-gorilla logo. He points to the machine's glass housing which is packed with various prize boxes. The camera pans slightly to follow his gestures toward the top display panel, emphasizing the brand logo PEILOLI. (3) The couple stands between a massive KING KONG machine on the left and a significantly smaller standard claw machine on the right to compare their sizes. Graphic text labels for Large and Small appear briefly. A small boy in a light blue sweater walks across the frame carrying a blue box, passing between the hosts and the arcade machines. (4) The man and woman face the camera directly for a closing segment. The man holds his hands together while speaking, and the woman nods and smiles broadly, expressing excitement. They are surrounded by the colorful, glowing arcade machines, with the yellow KING KONG unit clearly visible behind them as they conclude their presentation.
